meaning.en: To look longingly for someone's arrival or for news until one's eyes are strained.
meaning.zh: 形容殷切盼望，眼睛都要望穿了。

examples.zh: 母亲望穿秋水，盼着儿子回家过年。
examples.en: The mother watched longingly for her son to come home for New Year.

examples.zh: 她望穿秋水，也没等到那封信。
examples.en: She waited and watched, but the letter never came.

usage.en: Predicate; 秋水 is a poetic image of clear eyes.
usage.zh: 作谓语，“秋水”喻明亮的眼睛。

meaning.en: Graceful and charming in bearing, usually of a woman.
meaning.zh: 形容女子姿态柔美、风度优雅。

examples.zh: 年过五十，她依然风姿绰约。
examples.en: Past fifty, she is still graceful and charming.

examples.zh: 舞台上的舞者风姿绰约。
examples.en: The dancer on stage was graceful.

usage.zh: 作谓语，书面语，多形容女性。

natural: the donkey of Guizhou has run out of tricks

meaning.en: To be at the end of one's meagre abilities.
meaning.zh: 比喻本领有限，已经用完。

equivalents: at the end of one's tether
reach the limit of one's skill

examples.zh: 辩论到最后，他已黔驴技穷。
examples.en: By the end of the debate he was out of tricks.

examples.zh: 对方黔驴技穷，只好认输。
examples.en: The other side ran out of tricks and had to concede.

story.en: A donkey brought to Guizhou frightens a tiger until the tiger discovers its only trick is kicking, and eats it.
story.zh: 柳宗元《黔之驴》：驴蹄之，虎因喜曰：“技止此耳！”

natural: beds on beds, houses on houses

meaning.en: Needless duplication, such as redundant structures or wording.
meaning.zh: 床上叠床，屋上架屋，比喻重复累赘。

examples.zh: 这个部门叠床架屋，效率很低。
examples.en: This department is full of needless duplication and is very inefficient.

examples.zh: 文章叠床架屋，读来乏味。
examples.en: The essay is redundant and dull to read.

usage.en: Predicate; criticism of structure or writing.
usage.zh: 作谓语，批评机构或文章重复。

natural: make things difficult in every way

meaning.en: To put every obstacle in someone's way on purpose.
meaning.zh: 用各种办法故意为难别人。

equivalents: put every obstacle in the way

examples.zh: 办事员对申请人百般刁难。
examples.en: The clerk made every difficulty for the applicant.

examples.zh: 婆婆对新媳妇百般刁难。
examples.en: The mother-in-law made life hard for the new bride in every way.

meaning.en: People with no business being there; used in signs barring entry.
meaning.zh: 与某事无关的人，常见于告示。

examples.zh: 施工现场，闲杂人等不得入内。
examples.en: Building site: no entry for unauthorised persons.

examples.zh: 会议室门口写着“闲杂人等免进”。
examples.en: The meeting room door said “No admittance to unauthorised persons”.

natural: the warning lies close at hand

meaning.en: A cautionary precedent lies close by; learn from a recent failure.
meaning.zh: 殷商的教训并不遥远，比喻前人的失败就在眼前，应引以为鉴。

examples.zh: 同行破产的教训殷鉴不远，我们不能重蹈覆辙。
examples.en: The failure of our rivals is a warning close at hand; we mustn't repeat it.

examples.zh: 殷鉴不远，决策必须慎重。
examples.en: The warning lies close at hand; decisions must be made carefully.

story.en: The Book of Songs warns the Zhou king: the mirror of Yin is not far off; it lies in the age of the Xia (殷鉴不远，在夏后之世).

meaning.en: Indistinct and hard to make out.
meaning.zh: 形容模糊不清，不真切。

examples.zh: 远处影影绰绰有几个人影。
examples.en: Several figures were dimly visible in the distance.

examples.zh: 我只影影绰绰记得那件事。
examples.en: I only vaguely remember that matter.

meaning.en: Having no relatives or friends to turn to.
meaning.zh: 没有亲戚朋友，孤单无依。

examples.zh: 他在这座城市无亲无故。
examples.en: He has no friends or relatives in this city.

examples.zh: 老人无亲无故，靠邻居照顾。
examples.en: The old man has nobody and relies on his neighbours.

natural: pull chestnuts out of the fire

meaning.en: To take great risks for someone else's benefit and get nothing.
meaning.zh: 比喻冒着危险替别人出力，自己却一无所得。

equivalents: pull the chestnuts out of the fire

examples.zh: 别替他火中取栗，最后吃亏的是你。
examples.en: Don't pull chestnuts out of the fire for him; you'll be the loser.

examples.zh: 这笔生意风险大，无异于火中取栗。
examples.en: This deal is risky and amounts to pulling chestnuts from the fire.

meaning.en: To treat something as an unquestioned standard or guiding rule.
meaning.zh: 把某种言论或事物当作行为准则。

examples.zh: 他把老师的话奉为圭臬。
examples.en: He treated his teacher's words as gospel.

examples.zh: 这本手册被业界奉为圭臬。
examples.en: The handbook is revered as the industry standard.

meaning.en: To know how to make money by sound methods.
meaning.zh: 善于用正当的方法赚钱。

examples.zh: 他开了几家店，生财有道。
examples.en: He opened several shops and knows how to make money.

examples.zh: 生财有道，不必靠投机取巧。
examples.en: Making money properly doesn't need cutting corners.

meaning.en: To win people's support by favours or clever tactics.
meaning.zh: 用手段拉拢人，使人归附。

examples.zh: 他请客送礼，只为笼络人心。
examples.en: He gave dinners and gifts just to win people over.

examples.zh: 新官上任，先笼络人心。
examples.en: A new official first sets about winning people over.

meaning.en: Nothing new can be established until the old is cleared away.
meaning.zh: 不破除旧的，就不能建立新的。

equivalents: out with the old, in with the new
you can't build without first demolishing

examples.zh: 改革要不破不立，不能只修修补补。
examples.en: Reform requires clearing away the old; patching will not do.

examples.zh: 不破不立，旧体制必须打破。
examples.en: No building without breaking; the old system must go.

usage.en: Stand-alone saying; often 不塞不流，不止不行.
usage.zh: 可独立成句，常说“不破不立”。

meaning.en: A lucky day according to the traditional calendar, good for weddings and openings.
meaning.zh: 旧时指宜于办事的吉利日子。

examples.zh: 他们请人看了个黄道吉日结婚。
examples.en: They had someone choose an auspicious day for the wedding.

examples.zh: 搬家要挑黄道吉日。
examples.en: Choose a lucky day to move house.

usage.en: Noun; many still choose dates by it.
usage.zh: 作名词，现在仍有人择日办事。

natural: combine the scattered into a whole

meaning.en: To gather scattered pieces into a unified whole.
meaning.zh: 把分散的零碎部分集合成整体。

examples.zh: 银行把小额资金化零为整，用来投资。
examples.en: The bank pooled small sums into a whole for investment.

examples.zh: 游击队时而化整为零，时而化零为整。
examples.en: The guerrillas dispersed now, regrouped then.

usage.zh: 作谓语，与“化整为零”相对。

meaning.en: To copy something mechanically without understanding or originality.
meaning.zh: 照着样子模仿，没有创造性。

examples.zh: 他不懂原理，只会依葫芦画瓢。
examples.en: He doesn't understand the principle and can only copy.

examples.zh: 先依葫芦画瓢，再慢慢创新。
examples.en: Copy the model first, then innovate gradually.

natural: spread rumours and stir up trouble

meaning.en: To invent rumours and make trouble.
meaning.zh: 制造谣言，挑起事端。

examples.zh: 他到处造谣生事，搅得邻里不和。
examples.en: He spread rumours everywhere and set neighbours at odds.

examples.zh: 警方依法处理造谣生事者。
examples.en: The police deal with rumour-mongers according to law.

meaning.en: Passing the leadership's decisions and information down to the grassroots.
meaning.zh: 上级的意见和情况传达到下面。

examples.zh: 要做到上情下达，下情上达。
examples.en: Information must flow down and up alike.

examples.zh: 会议纪要保证了上情下达。
examples.en: The minutes ensure instructions reach the staff below.

usage.en: Usually paired with 下情上达.

meaning.en: The founder of a school, craft or genre.
meaning.zh: 首创某种事业或流派的人。

examples.zh: 他被誉为现代京剧的开山鼻祖。
examples.en: He is hailed as the founding father of modern Peking opera.

examples.zh: 这位作家是科幻小说的开山鼻祖。
examples.en: The author is the pioneer of science fiction.

meaning.en: With flesh badly torn, usually from a beating.
meaning.zh: 皮肉破裂，形容伤势很重，多指遭受毒打。

examples.zh: 他被打得皮开肉绽。
examples.en: He was beaten until his skin was torn open.

examples.zh: 摔下山坡，他摔得皮开肉绽。
examples.en: He fell down the slope and was badly torn up.

meaning.en: Grinning and joking in an unserious, cheeky way.
meaning.zh: 形容嬉笑不严肃的样子。

examples.zh: 犯了错还嬉皮笑脸，像什么话？
examples.en: Making a mistake and still grinning; what kind of attitude is that?

examples.zh: 他总是嬉皮笑脸，不认真做事。
examples.en: He's always grinning and never takes work seriously.

meaning.en: To be snubbed or refused; usually in 碰一鼻子灰.
meaning.zh: 指被拒绝、受冷遇，常说“碰了一鼻子灰”。

equivalents: come away with egg on one's face

examples.zh: 他去求人帮忙，碰了一鼻子灰。
examples.en: He went to ask for help and got snubbed.

examples.zh: 不听劝，早晚碰一鼻子灰。
examples.en: If you won't listen, you'll get your fingers burnt sooner or later.

usage.en: Used in 碰/落一鼻子灰; colloquial.
usage.zh: 常说“碰/落一鼻子灰”，口语。

meaning.en: To teach others patiently, never tiring.
meaning.zh: 教导别人不知疲倦。

examples.zh: 王老师诲人不倦，深受学生爱戴。
examples.en: Mr Wang teaches tirelessly and is much loved by his students.

examples.zh: 他一生诲人不倦，桃李满天下。
examples.en: He taught tirelessly all his life and has students everywhere.

story.en: Confucius: 'To learn without satiety and teach others without weariness' (学而不厌，诲人不倦).
story.zh: 《论语·述而》：“默而识之，学而不厌，诲人不倦，何有于我哉？”

usage.en: Predicate or attributive; praise for teachers.
